product_one_liner.value: Verifiable provides healthcare organizations with software and services to automate provider credentialing, primary-source verification, enrollment, and ongoing provider-network monitoring.
product_one_liner.notes: Based on the product overview and homepage.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer does not show a public pricing page; the site routes prospective buyers to request a demo.

named_customers.notes: Each name appears as a customer in Verifiable case-study pages.

employee_band.notes: Sources surfaced gave estimates spanning 51-200 and insufficiently reliable employee-count information to establish one of the required bands.

hq_location.notes: Company directory identifies Austin, Texas as its location/headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is primarily healthcare credentialing, product, and marketing content. It has a single technical engineering-stack post, which does not satisfy the required threshold of at least two engineering implementation posts.

public_docs.notes: The company site links to public API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Customer Success Manager, and Solutions Engineer; none is an AI/ML/data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed security information and public product/blog materials do not name an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Security page states SOC 2. Only the requested certification name is listed.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated July 10, 2023 reports a $27 million Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round identified is the Series B announced July 2023, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch announcement located was CredAgent, dated February 26, 2026, outside the six-month window before 2026-11-09; more recent blog material located was not a launch announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently verifiable team-history or dated announcement confirming or ruling out a C-level/VP change in the window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company documents its product's native Salesforce application and integration; no other CRM/sales-marketing system was supported by the reviewed sources.
